items.name: Linkub 2014
items.information: Open to everybody, but the maximum number of competitors is set to 40. When this number is reached registration closes. Email the organizer to be put on a waiting list. Your registration is only valid when you have payed the registration fee of 100SEK, though registration at competition day at the venue is allowed at an increased cost. Follow instructions on the competition page for payment.
